title: Fake-DOM piece 4: move observation-scan-due and lin-2933-cross-seam-witness onto loadWorld
description:
Piece 4 of LIN-4271's approved plan. **Blocked on piece 0** (`getElementById`, `·`, `insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend')`).

### Slice of the approved plan

| path | tests | API |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `tests/unit/observation-scan-due.test.js` | 51 | `getElementById` (36 red without it), `·` (`observation.js:3890`, 23 red), `insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend')` (`:3929`, 3 red, 3 more vacuous) |
| `tests/unit/lin-2933-cross-seam-witness.test.js` | 2 | none missing: `innerHTML` parse, class selectors, comma list, `.disabled`, `classList.toggle` (`observation.js:2688-2690`, `:3536-3556`, `:3788-3821`) |

Fake-internals replacements, each proven red under its mutation:

* `scan-due`: `list.innerHTML` regexes become `input.obs-due-select[data-issue-id="a"].checked`. Mutation: change `insertAdjacentHTML` to `innerHTML`; the append test goes red. The 3 tests that are vacuous today must become non-vacuous.
* `lin-2933`: `buttons.forEach` passes with zero buttons. Assert `buttons.length > 0` and draw the real row. Mutation: delete the re-enable loop in `restore()` (`observation.js:3551`).

Both ports are agent-reported only. This PR re-proves them.

**Rules for every move PR (from the plan):**

* Test names and counts stay the same. Before you touch a file: `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file> | sed -E 's/ \([0-9.]+ms\)$//' > before.txt`. After: the same into `after.txt`. Paste the empty `diff before.txt after.txt` and the pass counts into the PR. The counts must equal the plan's table.
* Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (`tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js:51`) **and** add it to the consumer paragraph in the `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` header, in the same PR (LIN-4265 comment `b6dfed3e`).
* Delete both copies in each suite: its own `FakeElement`/`FakeClassList` (or object-literal stubs) and its own `makeSandbox`/`load`/`vm.createContext`. Use `createFakeDom`/`loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js`).
* Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals. Map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards (the plan's "Fake-internals assertions" section). A replacement that cannot go red is a loosening and does not count.
* Every red that a real tree raises is a finding. The PR records each one as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Fix serializer differences (`disabled=""`, `hidden=""`, `checked=""`, escaping, parse errors on malformed markup or `<!doctype>`) in the test's regexes or fixtures, never by relaxing the fake.
* Never shim a missing shared-fake method in one file (no `doc.getElementById = …`). If you find a gap piece 0 missed, add it to `fake-dom.js` with its own `fake-dom.test.js` case, and say so on LIN-4271.
* LIN-4267/4268/4269 and the other pieces edit the same census list and header consumer paragraph. Before merge, update the branch against main and re-run CI on that head. `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` must be green on the merged head.
* Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js` (LIN-4272 files the follow-up), `select` support in the fake, and adding `style`/`getBoundingClientRect`/scroll/real event dispatch.

### Acceptance

* 51/51 and 2/2 pass with an empty name diff.
* Their own fakes and sandboxes are deleted.
* Both census entries are removed and both files are in the consumer paragraph.
* The two mutations are recorded red.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: **LIN-4271**. Read its description's `## Implementation Plan` (the approved plan, read at `473cc865`) and its `### Plan Review Verdict` comment `db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e`, which has notes for the builder. Above that sit grandparent LIN-4255 and its course-change note `b4a44c2e-1ce0-4108-a524-eb94c3abfaee`. **The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts.** Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4271 (and on LIN-4255 if it changes the course-change note).

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4271's approving plan-review (comment db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e, rev 1)
* Grounding commit: `473cc865` (LinearViewer origin/main; the plan's read commit, still HEAD at breakdown on 2026-11-05, with no commits since to `tests/unit/helpers/`, the census, the fixture or the client files). Earlier beats read at `6d287518`.

### Implemented (close-out)

Implemented as the approved plan described, with no deviations: `observation-scan-due` (51/51) and `lin-2933-cross-seam-witness` (2/2) now run on `loadWorld`/`world.run`; both left `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and joined the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph. PR: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2308](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2308>), squash-merged as `6dd13617`. The problem statement, rules and acceptance above are kept as written: this description embeds no plan, research or scoping sections, so nothing was pruned. The full pre-close description is preserved in the task snapshots (`GET /api/proxy/issues/LIN-4283/snapshots`) and the history is in the comment trail.

comments.body: LIN-4280 (PR #2304, merged as `82e75ee9`) added `world.run(code)` to `tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js` (a script-scope seam, with `tests/unit/client-world.test.js`). `observation-scan-due.test.js` still sets `currentView` with a raw `vm.runInContext`; when you port it, use `world.run` so the raw vm line goes too, as `observation-basis-check` now does. The census list and `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph are at 47 / updated on main.

**Beat 1/4 (LIN-4283): lin-2933 ported, scan-due not committed.** Branch `feat/lin-4283-scan-due-lin-2933-loadworld`, commit `5d6f58c2` (local, not pushed).

- `lin-2933-cross-seam-witness`: own FakeElement/FakeClassList/makeSandbox/vm removed. Real `common.js` + `observation.js` through `loadWorld`; the ruling row is parsed into the fake DOM. 2/2 pass, spec output identical to the baseline.
- Non-vacuity: `buttons.length > 0` asserted. With the option button removed from the row, both cases fail on it.
- Mutation: deleting the re-enable loop in `restore()` (`observation.js:3551`) turns both cases red (`true !== false`). File restored, diff empty.
- Census entry for lin-2933 left in place per the beat plan, so `fake-dom-census.test.js` reports a stale entry on this commit. The census beat removes it.
- `observation-scan-due` port exists only as a saved patch, not committed (beat boundary). Under the append→innerHTML mutation it is 4 red after the port (the 3 load-more selection tests had been vacuous for that mutation).

**LIN-4283 (piece 4) PR is open and CI is green: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2308** (head `168bc48c`, not merged; merge is gated on review).

**Scope.** `observation-scan-due` (51 tests) and `lin-2933-cross-seam-witness` (2 tests) now run on `loadWorld` and `world.run`. Their own fakes and `vm` sandboxes are gone. Both files leave `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and join the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph. No `public/` change.

**Evidence on the pushed head.**
- Name diffs empty, with the `duration_ms` line excluded: scan-due 51/51, lin-2933 2/2.
- `fake-dom-census.test.js` 43/43. `client-world` 3/3. `fake-dom` 87/87.
- Full `npm run test:unit`: 23,744 pass, 0 fail, exit 0.
- Mutation proof, 28 scripted mutations, all red, restores clean. Table is in the PR body.
- CI on `168bc48c`, all green: Unit tests, E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4, Secret scan (source), CI success.

**Findings.** Fixed: the three vacuous load-more selection tests (now drawn-row checks); lin-2933 zero-button vacuity; refusal-clear now checks the drawn element; APPENDS failure message. No real-tree reds. Fake artefact, documented: `selectAll.indeterminate` is a plain expando.

**Follow-up.** LIN-4286: the untested `catch` branch of `loadInitialDueCheckPage` (pre-existing gap, not from this port).

**Plan note.** Posted on LIN-4271: the rules' `diff before.txt after.txt` needs the `duration_ms` line stripped to be empty.

## Review — LIN-4283

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2308 at head `168bc48c`. The PR's base is `069585bb`. Since then main has moved to `d537cd69` (LIN-4267), which touches the census and the `fake-dom.js` header.

CI: green on `168bc48c` (Unit tests, E2E 1/4 to 4/4, Secret scan, CI success). That run predates `d537cd69`, so it does not cover the merged head.

### Scope vs plan
The PR changes exactly the four files the slice names: the two suites, `fake-dom-census.test.js` and `helpers/fake-dom.js`. Nothing in `public/` changed, and nothing outside the slice. Neither suite has any `vm`, `createContext`, `FakeElement`/`FakeClassList` or local `getElementById` left. `currentView` and `observationData` are set through `world.run`. The `makeSandbox` name survives only as a thin wrapper over `loadWorld`, the same shape as `observation-basis-check`. The plan allows that.

### Independent re-runs (all mine, on a worktree)
- **Name diff** (`sed` per the plan, `duration_ms` excluded): I ran the `069585bb` versions of both suites against the PR versions. Both diffs are **empty**. scan-due **51/51**, lin-2933 **2/2**. This matches the plan's table.
- **Helpers**: `fake-dom-census` + `client-world` + `fake-dom` 133/133.
- **Mutation M1** (`list.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html)` → `list.innerHTML = html`, `observation.js:3929`): ported suite **4 red**. The reds are APPENDS, loaded-rows-only, select-all-loaded across load-more, and survives loadMoreDueChecks. Under the same mutation the original suite is only 1 red, which confirms the three selection tests used to be vacuous and now are not.
- **Mutation M11** (delete the re-enable line in `restore()`, `observation.js:3551`): lin-2933 **2/2 red**.
- **Zero-button vacuity**: with the button removed from `drawRow`, both cases fail on `the row has its option buttons drawn`.
- **Spot-checks from the PR's table**: M2 (row `checked` never set, `:3886`) gives 3 red. M3 (coverable `indeterminate` forced to false, `:4040`) gives 1 red. Both match the table.
- Every mutation was reverted and `git status` was clean afterwards.
- **Merged head** (local merge of `origin/main` into `168bc48c`): the merge is clean. Census + both suites + fake-dom + client-world: **186/186**. The header has both the LIN-4267 and LIN-4283 entries.

### Regression check
`git log` on the touched files shows only the LIN-4280, LIN-4269 and LIN-4267 fake-DOM moves. No fix was reverted or re-applied. Assertions were made stricter, never looser, and the `selectAll.indeterminate` expando is documented as a fake artefact that a browser shares.

### Class check
This change is one instance of the "hand-written fake-DOM suite → `loadWorld`" class. The remaining census entries in this family are owned by sibling pieces LIN-4281/4282/4284/4285, so they are **outside** this ticket's slice and not unhandled. The pre-existing untested `catch` in `loadInitialDueCheckPage` is **outside** (different problem), and it is already filed as LIN-4286.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the plan's merge rule: census green on the merged head). CI ran on `168bc48c`, before `d537cd69` (LIN-4267) changed the same census list and header paragraph. I merged locally and that is green, but CI never ran on the merged head. **Settle before the merge:** update the branch against main, then confirm CI is green on the new head. That head must include `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` passing. Siblings 4281/4282/4284/4285 are editing the same list, so re-check this if main moves again before the merge.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. Every acceptance item held when I re-ran it myself: 51/51 and 2/2 with empty name diffs, the fakes and sandboxes are deleted, the census and header are updated, and M1 and M11 go red (zero-button too). The only open item is CI on the branch updated against main.

## Close-out — LIN-4283

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2308, squash-merged as `6dd13617`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 52d8874e`. Review verdict was Approve, conditional on the ledger item below. The change is test-only (no `public/` change, no deploy workflow), so there were no post-deploy steps.

**Changes I made after the approval** (both answer the review's one ledger line, "update the branch against main, confirm CI green on the new head"):
- `661da233`: merged `d537cd69` (LIN-4267) into the branch. No conflicts.
- `52d8874e`: main moved again to `48d93c5c` (LIN-4284) while CI ran on `661da233`, and the PR went conflicting. The one conflict was the comment-only consumer paragraph in `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`; I resolved it by keeping both the LIN-4284 and LIN-4283 entries. No code or assertion changed.

**Ledger**
- *Inside — CI never ran on the merged head (census green on it):* settled. Before the merge, main was still `48d93c5c`, which `52d8874e` includes. CI ran on exactly `52d8874e`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1/4–4/4, Secret scan, CI success all SUCCESS, PR `CLEAN`. I also ran locally on that head: census + scan-due + lin-2933 + fake-dom + client-world + chart-helpers + sentinel-mask, 235/235. On merged main `6dd13617`: census + scan-due + lin-2933, 96/96 (43 + 51 + 2). The post-merge `main` CI run was still queued when I closed.
- *Outside — the untested `catch` in `loadInitialDueCheckPage`:* already filed as LIN-4286 (pre-existing gap). I set Priority Low and the `Improvement` label (the catalog has no test/chore type), linked it `related` to this ticket, and recorded the reasoning on it. No other existing ticket named this file and finding.
- *Outside — the other hand-written fake-DOM suites:* owned by sibling pieces LIN-4281/4282/4284/4285, so I filed nothing.
- No named monitor or rollback was written in the review, and none was needed (test-only change).

**Not re-run by me:** the 28-mutation table and the M1/M11 red proofs. I relied on the review's independent re-run at `168bc48c`. The only edits since are the two merges above, which touched no suite code.

**Description:** archived first (snapshot `b0d8112b…` confirmed in `/snapshots`). Nothing was pruned because the description embeds no plan, research or scoping sections. I appended a short implemented-as-planned stub with the PR link.

**Related tickets:** the siblings and the parent LIN-4271 are other pieces and stay open.

## Autopilot run summary — LIN-4283 (stepper)

**Outcome:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2308 squash-merged as `6dd13617` (head `52d8874e`); LIN-4283 is Done.

**Beats run (one warm session, 4 beats, then review and close-out as fresh sessions):**
1. Set up, baselines (51/51, 2/2), port lin-2933 (`5d6f58c2`). Both lin-2933 mutations red.
2. Port observation-scan-due onto loadWorld/world.run (`a4eb7a97`). 51/51, name diff empty (duration_ms line excluded), no raw vm.
3. Re-proved every fake-internals replacement (28 scripted mutations, all red, restores clean); strengthened the refusal-clear test (`ec85d06b`).
4. Census + fake-dom.js header bookkeeping, PR, CI, Linear notes; follow-up LIN-4286 filed; plan note posted on LIN-4271.
- Review (fresh session): Approve, conditional on CI on a branch updated against main (comment 3de22284). It re-ran the name diffs and the append/re-enable/zero-button mutations itself.
- Close-out: merged main twice (LIN-4267, LIN-4284; one comment-only conflict in the fake-dom.js consumer paragraph), CI green on exact merged head `52d8874e` (Unit tests, E2E 1/4-4/4, Secret scan, CI success), merged, set Done.

**Held:** 51/51 and 2/2 with empty name diffs; own fakes and sandboxes deleted (`makeSandbox` kept only as a thin loadWorld wrapper, as in sibling suites); both census entries removed and both files in the consumer paragraph; required mutations recorded red.

**Left / not proven:** the 28 mutations were not re-run on the merged head (only merge edits since, none touch suite code). The post-merge CI run on main was still queued when close-out finished. Pre-existing untested `catch` in `loadInitialDueCheckPage` is LIN-4286. Sibling pieces LIN-4281/4282/4284/4285 and parent LIN-4271 remain open.
